# Speech generation and language-model-based TTS

<!-- Generated by scripts/catalog.py from data/models.json. Edit the JSON, then regenerate. -->

[← Model index](../README.md#models)

**Reviewed as of 2026-09-12 · 64 entries.**

Autoregressive, masked-token, diffusion-language-model and continuous-latent LM approaches to speech synthesis. A speech reference in the input column usually conditions voice or continuation; it does not establish speech understanding. Scripted dialogue TTS does not generate the conversational answer itself.

**Modalities:** T = text, I = image, V = video, A = general audio, S = speech, M = music, X = other structured modalities. A is a broad label, not a guarantee of every audio task. See the [methodology](../docs/methodology.md) for interaction labels, variant scope and inclusion rules.

Dates below refer to the linked paper or announcement, **not necessarily a weights/API release**. An em dash means no date was established from the reviewed source.

## Model notes

<a id="bark"></a>

### Bark

Text-conditioned speech, nonverbal sounds and some music generation.

**Listed variants:** Bark; Bark Small.

<a id="base-tts"></a>

### BASE TTS

Models discrete speech codes with an incremental waveform decoder.

<a id="chatterbox"></a>

### Chatterbox

Family of reference-conditioned speech synthesizers; capabilities vary by release.

**Listed variants:** Original; Multilingual V2; Multilingual V3; Turbo; Nano; Single Language Pack.

<a id="chattts"></a>

### ChatTTS

Synthesizes conversational delivery from supplied text; does not itself answer a user's questions.

<a id="clam-tts"></a>

### CLaM-TTS

Predicts multiple codec tokens jointly to reduce generation cost.

<a id="cosyvoice"></a>

### CosyVoice

Text-conditioned multilingual synthesis and voice conditioning.

**Listed variants:** 300M; SFT; Instruct.

<a id="cosyvoice-2"></a>

### CosyVoice 2

Supports streaming text input and audio output.

**Listed variants:** 0.5B.

<a id="cosyvoice-3"></a>

### CosyVoice 3

Extends coverage and control of the CosyVoice streaming synthesis line.

**Listed variants:** Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B.

<a id="csm"></a>

### CSM

Conversational Speech Model renders speech from text and audio context; the public checkpoint is not a complete voice assistant.

**Listed variants:** CSM-1B.

<a id="dia"></a>

### Dia

Renders a speaker-tagged script into multi-speaker speech with optional audio context.

**Listed variants:** 1.6B.

<a id="dia2"></a>

### Dia2

Starts synthesis from partial text and supports audio prefix conditioning.

**Listed variants:** 1B; 2B.

<a id="ella-v"></a>

### ELLA-V

Interleaves phonemes and acoustic codes to stabilize autoregressive synthesis.

<a id="fireredtts"></a>

### FireRedTTS

Foundation TTS system for expressive and reference-conditioned speech.

<a id="fireredtts-2"></a>

### FireRedTTS-2

Generates context-aware multi-speaker speech from dialogue text.

<a id="openaudio-s1"></a>

### Fish Audio S1 / OpenAudio S1

Expressive TTS family also known as OpenAudio S1; the model card distinguishes the full S1 model and distilled S1-mini.

**Listed variants:** S1; S1-mini.

<a id="fish-audio-s2"></a>

### Fish Audio S2

Instruction-controlled multi-speaker, multi-turn speech synthesis.

**Listed variants:** S2; S2-Pro.

<a id="fish-speech"></a>

### Fish Speech

Separates semantic sequence modeling from grouped acoustic-token prediction.

**Listed variants:** Fish Speech release family.

<a id="gemini-2-5-tts"></a>

### Gemini 2.5 TTS

Specialized speech-generation endpoints; separate from the Live API.

**Listed variants:** 2.5 Flash Preview TTS; 2.5 Pro Preview TTS.

<a id="gemini-3-1-flash-tts"></a>

### Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS

Text-conditioned speech generation with controllable delivery.

**Listed variants:** gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview.

<a id="glm-tts"></a>

### GLM-TTS

Post-training improves controllable pronunciation, speaker similarity and prosody.

<a id="gpt-4o-mini-tts"></a>

### GPT-4o Mini TTS

Generates spoken audio from text and delivery instructions.

**Listed variants:** gpt-4o-mini-tts.

<a id="gpt-sovits"></a>

### GPT-SoVITS

Few-shot and zero-shot synthesis using reference audio; the WebUI's separate ASR tools are not part of its language model.

**Listed variants:** v1; v2; v3; v4; v2 Pro; v2 ProPlus.

<a id="higgs-audio-v2"></a>

### Higgs Audio v2

Text and acoustic context condition expressive speech generation.

**Listed variants:** 3B Base.

<a id="higgs-audio-v2-5"></a>

### Higgs Audio v2.5

Successor synthesis release in the Higgs Audio line.

**Listed variants:** v2.5.

<a id="higgs-audio-v3-tts"></a>

### Higgs Audio v3 TTS

Standalone successor with voice conditioning and text-controlled delivery.

**Listed variants:** 4B; higgs-tts-3-4b.

<a id="hume-octave-tts"></a>

### Hume Octave TTS

Commercial TTS interface with voice design and reference conditioning; EVI 4-mini combines it with an external language model.

**Listed variants:** Octave 1; Octave 2.

<a id="indextts"></a>

### IndexTTS

Extends the XTTS/Tortoise approach with improved pronunciation control.

**Listed variants:** IndexTTS; IndexTTS-1.5.

<a id="indextts-2-5"></a>

### IndexTTS 2.5

Extends IndexTTS2 with multilingual coverage and efficiency improvements.

**Listed variants:** 2.5.

<a id="indextts2"></a>

### IndexTTS2

Separates emotion and timbre control and adds explicit duration conditioning.

**Listed variants:** 2.

<a id="kyutai-tts-dsm"></a>

### Kyutai TTS (DSM)

Aligns text and audio streams with controlled delays for incremental synthesis.

**Listed variants:** Kyutai TTS.

<a id="llasa"></a>

### Llasa

Uses a single Transformer for language-model-based speech synthesis.

**Listed variants:** 1B; 3B; 8B.

<a id="llasa-plus"></a>

### Llasa+

Adds acceleration modules and streaming synthesis to the Llasa backbone.

<a id="maskgct"></a>

### MaskGCT

Non-autoregressive token language modeling without explicit text-speech alignment.

<a id="mega-tts"></a>

### Mega-TTS

Uses separate inductive biases for content, timbre, prosody and waveform generation.

<a id="mega-tts-2"></a>

### Mega-TTS 2

Improves prompt utilization and transfer of speaking style.

<a id="minimax-speech"></a>

### MiniMax-Speech

Learnable speaker conditioning supports expressive multilingual TTS.

**Listed variants:** Research model family.

<a id="moss-tts"></a>

### MOSS-TTS

Family includes structurally distinct generators over MOSS audio tokens.

**Listed variants:** Delay 8B v1/v1.5; Local Transformer 1.7B/4B v1.5.

<a id="moss-tts-nano"></a>

### MOSS-TTS-Nano

Lightweight member of the MOSS-TTS family.

**Listed variants:** MOSS-TTS-Nano.

<a id="moss-tts-realtime"></a>

### MOSS-TTS-Realtime

The real-time TTS specialization of the MOSS speech-generation family.

**Listed variants:** MOSS-TTS-Realtime.

<a id="moss-ttsd"></a>

### MOSS-TTSD

Turns speaker-tagged scripts into multi-party spoken dialogue.

<a id="moss-voicegenerator"></a>

### MOSS-VoiceGenerator

Creates speaking voices from natural-language descriptions.

<a id="omnivoice"></a>

### OmniVoice

Omnilingual TTS over multiple acoustic codebooks; its name does not imply vision input.

<a id="orpheus-tts"></a>

### Orpheus TTS

Expressive synthesis with textual emotion cues and voice conditioning.

**Listed variants:** 3B English; multilingual preview.

<a id="outetts"></a>

### OuteTTS

TTS models usable through standard LLM inference backends.

**Listed variants:** 0.1; 0.2; 0.3; 1.0.

<a id="parler-tts"></a>

### Parler-TTS

Uses text descriptions of the speaker and delivery to guide synthesis.

**Listed variants:** Mini; Large; Mini Expresso.

<a id="pocket-tts"></a>

### Pocket TTS

Small streaming synthesizer derived from continuous audio language modeling.

**Listed variants:** 100M.

<a id="qwen3-tts"></a>

### Qwen3-TTS

Family offers voice cloning, preset voices and description-driven voice creation; input conditioning depends on variant.

**Listed variants:** 0.6B; 1.7B; Base; CustomVoice; VoiceDesign; 12Hz/25Hz tokenizers.

<a id="rall-e"></a>

### RALL-E

Predicts pitch and duration as intermediate conditions for speech synthesis.

<a id="seed-tts"></a>

### Seed-TTS

Research family with controllable synthesis and speaker prompting.

**Listed variants:** Autoregressive Seed-TTS.

<a id="spark-tts"></a>

### Spark-TTS

Separates semantic tokens from global speaker tokens for controllable synthesis.

**Listed variants:** 0.5B.

<a id="spear-tts"></a>

### SPEAR-TTS

Separates reading and speaking to reduce paired-data requirements.

<a id="step-audio-tts"></a>

### Step-Audio-TTS

Dedicated synthesizer distributed with Step-Audio; separate from Step-Audio-Chat.

**Listed variants:** 3B.

<a id="tortoise-tts"></a>

### Tortoise TTS

Reference-conditioned synthesis from a scaled generative speech pipeline.

<a id="vall-e"></a>

### VALL-E

Treats synthesis as conditional prediction of neural codec tokens.

<a id="vall-e-2"></a>

### VALL-E 2

Improves robustness of zero-shot speech synthesis.

<a id="vall-e-x"></a>

### VALL-E X

Uses reference speech and target text for cross-lingual synthesis and translation.

<a id="vall-t"></a>

### VALL-T

Adds monotonic generation constraints to prompt-based speech synthesis.

<a id="vibevoice"></a>

### VibeVoice

Synthesizes long scripted conversations; ASR is a separate model in the same project.

**Listed variants:** 1.5B; 7B.

<a id="vibevoice-realtime"></a>

### VibeVoice-Realtime

Incremental text-to-speech member of the VibeVoice family.

**Listed variants:** 0.5B.

<a id="voicecraft"></a>

### VoiceCraft

Supports both speech editing and reference-conditioned TTS.

**Listed variants:** 330M; 830M.

<a id="voxcpm"></a>

### VoxCPM

Tokenizer-free speech generation with voice conditioning.

**Listed variants:** VoxCPM; VoxCPM1.5.

<a id="voxcpm2"></a>

### VoxCPM2

Extends VoxCPM with multilingual generation and description-based voice control.

**Listed variants:** 2B.

<a id="xtts"></a>

### XTTS

Multilingual reference-conditioned TTS derived from Tortoise.

**Listed variants:** XTTS; XTTS-v2.

<a id="zonos"></a>

### Zonos

Speech synthesis conditioned on text, speaker references and delivery attributes.

**Listed variants:** v0.1 Transformer; v0.1 Hybrid.
